response.summary: Round 5 resolves both round-4 findings, and I found no new material defects. R4-F1: the `pixel()` helper in surfaces.cjs now takes a fullPage screenshot. It converts the viewport-relative `boundingBox()` to document coordinates by adding `scrollX`/`scrollY`, and averages a 6×6 area on a canvas. So the ledger no longer has to be inside the 858px viewport, and one noise pixel can't skew the reading. At 1048px the sample points land where intended: ledger x+12 is inside the 1px border and 8px radius, and ledger x−16 and rail x−10 fall in main's roughly 31px padding, to the right of the 216px sidebar. R4-F2: decision 5 now darkens the Home ledger numerals to `--muted` #616660, about 4.9–5.0:1 on the sheet and the current-row wash by my calculation. Lines 17 and 14 assert 4.5:1 on the actual parent backgrounds. Earlier findings stay resolved in the plan and script: full-bleed ground through route-guarded :has; the five separator ranges; uniform row geometry with an inside stripe; mobile padding; replacing the ledger shadow outright; exact tones with a 220px top light; strip-only day edges via media plus `width>36rem`; the column-count versus border loop at 100% and 200%; scoped contrast samples. Nothing has been implemented yet, so the implementation and its browser proofs still need inspecting.
